extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent attorneys, classification specialists, and patent applicants
extracted.subtask_description: CPC subclass A41C classification scheme for corsets, girdles and brassieres, listing main groups, subgroups, materials, features, component parts, manufacturing methods and cross-references to other CPC/IPC places. Used to determine where patent documents on these garments should be classified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warning: non-limiting references
rubrics_metrics.description: {In this subclass, non-limiting references (in the sense of paragraph 39 of the Guide to the IPC) may still be displayed in the scheme.}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that references shown in the scheme may be non-limiting; consult paragraph 39 of the Guide to the IPC for interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/00 Corsets or girdles
rubrics_metrics.guidance: {Panty-girdles} — principal group for corsets/girdles including panty-girdles.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/003 Corsets or girdles provided with means preventing the riding-up of the garment
rubrics_metrics.description: . {Corsets or girdles provided with means preventing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subgroup addressing anti-riding-up measures for corsets/girdles (see 1/006 continuation).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/006 (anti-riding-up continuation)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Continuation of anti-riding-up subgroup (1/003).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/02 made of rubber
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify corsets/girdles made primarily of rubber under this subgroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/04 Elastic corsets
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corsets/girdles characterized by elastic construction.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/06 with brassieres
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corsets or girdles combined with brassieres; cross-links to brassiere groups as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/08 Abdominal supports
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corset-like articles intended as abdominal supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/10 Maternity corsets
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corsets specially adapted for maternity use.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/12 Component parts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parts of corsets/girdles (components not the complete garment) to be classified here.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/14 Stays; Steels
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stiffening elements for corsets; see also stay-related brassiere subclasses.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/16 made of wire
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stays or other corset elements made of wire are classified here.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/18 of built-up type
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Built-up type corset constructions (multi-part assemblies).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/20 with protective caps
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corset/stay ends having protective caps or similar end protections.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/00 Brassieres
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Main group for brassieres and related variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/0007 with stay means
rubrics_metrics.description: . {with stay means (A41C 3/06 takes precedence; stay means per se A41C 3/122)}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres with stay means; note that A41C 3/06 takes precedence for some items and stay means per se are classified in A41C 3/122.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/0014 made from one piece with one or several layers
rubrics_metrics.description: . {made from one piece with one or several layers}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres constructed from a single piece possibly with multiple layers.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/0021 with suspension construction for the breasts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres that use a suspension-type construction to support the breasts.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/0028 with size and configuration adjustment means
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Features allowing size/configuration adjustment (e.g., adjustable straps, adjustable cup configuration).

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/0035 with pockets
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres that include pockets (e.g., for pads or prostheses).

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/0042 diffusing perfume or the like
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres incorporating scent-diffusing features or similar fragrance delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/005 specially adapted for specific purposes
rubrics_metrics.description: . {specially adapted for specific purposes (prosthetic brassieres A41C 3/148)}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres adapted for particular uses; prosthetic brassieres specifically referenced to A41C 3/148.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/0057 for sport activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres designed for sports use (support during physical activity).

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/0064 for medical use or surgery
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Medical or surgical brassieres; see related medical classes if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/0071 with interchangeable or detachable cups
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres whose cups can be removed or swapped.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/0078 with backless strap feature
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres designed to allow backless wearing or specialized strap arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/0085 with ventilation feature
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres designed with ventilation or breathable constructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/0092 with different cup sizes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres that offer differing cup sizes or cup-size differentiation features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brassieres with front closures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres that close at the front rather than the back; classify here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brassieres for nursing mothers
rubrics_metrics.description: for nursing mothers {(nursing clothing in general A41D 1/215)}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres designed for breastfeeding/nursing mothers; cross-reference to nursing clothing general group A41D 1/215.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strapless brassieres
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres lacking shoulder straps (strapless designs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Brassieres attached directly to the body
rubrics_metrics.description: . {attached directly to the body, e.g. by means of adhesive}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhesive or body-attached brassieres (stick-on types) to be classified here.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/08 combined with other garments
rubrics_metrics.description: 3/08 . combined with other garments (with corsets A41C 1/06)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres combined with other garments; cross-reference to corsets group A41C 1/06 where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/10 with inflatable inserts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres incorporating inflatable elements (e.g., inflatable inserts).

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/105 with stiffening or bust-forming inserts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres including inserts intended to stiffen or shape the bust.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/12 Component parts (brassieres)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individual parts of brassieres (separate from whole garments).

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/122 Stay means (brassieres)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stay means per se for brassieres; cross-reference to stay means for corsets A41C 1/14.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/124 with an articulated or bridge construction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres employing articulated pieces or bridge-like constructions (e.g., specialized center pieces).

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/126 with additional means provided at the ends
rubrics_metrics.description: 3/126 . {with additional means provided at the ends, e.g. for protection}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: End-protection features on brassiere components (caps, end-protection for stays, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: 5/00 Machines, appliances, or methods for manufacturing corsets or brassieres
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Group for manufacturing equipment, appliances or methods relating to corsets and brassieres.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5/005 manufacturing by moulding (thermoforming)
rubrics_metrics.description: 5/005 manufacturing corsets or brassieres . {by moulding (shaping of textile material made from plastics fibres by thermoforming B29C 51/004)}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manufacturing by moulding or thermoforming; cross-reference to B29C 51/004 for shaping textile/plastic fibres by thermoforming.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/128 using specific materials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres characterized by the use of particular materials; see further subgroups for material-specific features.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/14 Stiffening or bust-forming inserts (detailed)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Group for various types of inserts intended to stiffen or form the bust; further subgroups provide details.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/142 Stiffening inserts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inserts whose primary purpose is stiffening (distinct from padding).

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/144 Pads
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Padding elements (pads) used in brassieres to shape or augment appearance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/146 containing liquid or gel filling
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inserts or pads containing liquid or gel fillings for shaping or comfort.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/148 Prosthetic brassieres
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brassieres intended as prosthetic devices for breast replacement; cross-reference to medical prostheses A61F 2/52 for non-implantable mammary prostheses.
